**Syddanmark Region i alt** (Region of Southern Denmark in total) is the aggregate statistical entity representing the entire Region of Southern Denmark within the Danish Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen, or AKDB). It encompasses all hospitals within the region and serves as a primary unit for regional and national benchmarking in acute surgical care [^src1] [^src2] [^src3] [^src4]. As a designated subregion of [[danmark|Danmark]], it provides essential aggregated data for evaluating clinical quality, risk adjustment, and healthcare performance across the country [^src3].

The entity's data is prominently featured in the AKDB's annual reports, including the 2023 and 2024 publications. These reports utilize the aggregated regional figures to analyze patient demographics, such as age and gender distributions for patients undergoing acute surgery between September 1, 2022, and August 31, 2023 [^src4]. Furthermore, "Syddanmark Region i alt" is a key component in supplementary indicator analyses. This includes tracking the distribution of cancer diagnoses among operated patients, evaluating 90-day mortality (Indicator 11), and measuring 30-day mortality for patients with high comorbidity—specifically those with a Charlson Comorbidity Index score of 3 or higher (Indicators 9a, 9b, and 10c) [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. 

By providing these comprehensive regional totals, the entity allows health authorities and the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) to adjust quality metrics, identify areas for clinical improvement, and compare local hospital outcomes against the broader regional and national averages [^src3] [^src4].
